title: Get erorr when run Image classification with Vision Transformer
author: Vudao0407

comments.author: sachinprasadhs
comments.body:
Hi,

Since the tutorial uses Keras 3, you need to install TensorFlow 2.15 and Keras 3.0 to run this in colab.

Adding 
```
!pip install -q tensorflow==2.15.0
!pip install -q keras==3.0.0
``` 
will resolve the issue.

Here is the working Gist for reference https://gist.github.com/sachinprasadhs/63b6348d94994f73421dafaefd8cdcec
